name: FrontendBench
description: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant strides in front-end code generation. However, existing benchmarks exhibit several critical limitations: many tasks are overly simplistic, test cases often lack rigor, and end-to-end validation is absent. These issues hinder the accurate assessment of model performance.
reputation: A recent benchmark aimed at more realistic front-end code generation evaluation, but it is still early in community adoption.
notes: Code benchmark with end-to-end validation; likely sensitive to environment setup and test harness quality, and not yet widely saturated.
